{
  "name": "claude-council",
  "version": "2026.10.7",
  "description": "Consult multiple AI coding agents (Gemini, OpenAI, Grok, Perplexity, Kimi, any model OpenRouter routes to, plus codex, antigravity, grok, kimi and cursor CLIs when installed, and a local ollama model) to get diverse perspectives on coding problems, with a streaming pane in tmux or inside Claude Code, and, once switched on, a heads-up side-check where one council seat, codex by default, rereads a long turn and shows one line above the prompt about something you may have missed.",
  "author": {
    "name": "hex",
    "url": "https://github.com/hex"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/hex/claude-council",
  "repository": "https://github.com/hex/claude-council",
  "icon": "./assets/icon.png",
  "types": "./mods/council-pane/types/index.d.ts",
  "keywords": [
    "multi-agent",
    "council",
    "second-opinion",
    "code-review",
    "consensus",
    "perspectives",
    "gemini",
    "openai",
    "grok",
    "perplexity",
    "kimi",
    "openrouter",
    "codex",
    "antigravity",
    "ollama",
    "cli",
    "pane",
    "tmux",
    "mod",
    "heads-up"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "pane_host": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pane opens in",
      "description": "One of: ask, claude-code, tmux. Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. claude-code draws the pane inside Claude Code; tmux leaves it to the tmux pane; ask puts the question once inside tmux and remembers the answer.",
      "default": "ask"
    },
    "collapse_when_done": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Collapse status when done",
      "description": "Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. Replace the provider list with a one-line summary once a run finishes.",
      "default": true
    },
    "wake_on_async_done": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Wake on async finish",
      "description": "Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. Submit a prompt when a background council run completes. Starts a model turn, which costs tokens.",
      "default": false
    },
    "council_tool": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Council as a tool",
      "description": "Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. Let the model call the council as a tool. Every call first asks you to confirm, because the council sends the question to third-party providers.",
      "default": true
    },
    "heads_up": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Heads-up side-check",
      "description": "Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. While Claude works a long turn, one council seat, codex by default, rereads the last five turns and the last eight tool results and may show one line above the prompt. Nothing asks before a send: that material leaves the machine on every check. A project's .claude/council-heads-up.json can turn it on or off for that project alone and pick the seat and cadence.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
